EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} is today! I feel
like I've been waiting for this day
for forever!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}I can't wait for it to start!

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Hoy es el Torneo de Pesca!
¡He estado esperando este día
una eternidad! {{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡A ver si empieza!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le tournoi de pêche est sur le point

que j'attends ce moment !
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}J'ai trop hâte que ça commence !

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oggi c'è il {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}torneo di pesca{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!

{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Non vedo l'ora che inizi!

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Balık Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} bugün! Bu günü sanki

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Today's {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} is serious
business!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} From start to finish, you
can't let up at all!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}¡El Torneo de Pesca de hoy es
algo muy serio!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} ¡No puedo bajar
la guardia ni un solo segundo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Le tournoi de pêche, c'est du
sérieux !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} Il faut rester concentré du

{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Il torneo di pesca non va preso
sotto gamba!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} Serve concentrazione
dall'inizio alla fine!

Wettkampf!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} Man muss von Anfang
bis Ende voll bei der Sache sein!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}It's a festival for bros and ladybros
who are as strong as the sea! That's
what the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} is!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh! And rivers. As strong as rivers.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡Aquí llega ese festival para los
troncos y troncas que se crean
tan fuertes como el mar!
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡Ah! Y como los ríos. O MÁS
fuertes que los ríos, ¡que no tienen
olas! ¡Es el Torneo de Pesca!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Le tournoi de pêche, c'est un duel
entre toi et les forces de la nature !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}C'est comme{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0010:}}faire un bras de fer
avec le bras d'une rivière !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Il torneo di pesca è per tutti quelli
che sono forti come il mare
in tempesta!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh! E anche come i fiumi in piena.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Deniz kadar güçlü bro ve bro-ablaların
festivali! İşte {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Balık Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
budur!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ha! Nehirleri de unutmayayım.
Nehir kadar güçlü!

EN:
Finally! {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0003:0014:}} Waaaaaaa!
I'm so excited! I can't stop shaking!
ES:
¡Al fin! ¡El Torneo de Pesca!
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}¡Aaaaaay! ¡Tiemblo de la emoción!
IT:
Ci siamo! Il torneo di pesca è qui!
{{TAG:0003:0014:}}Sono così contento!
Ho tutti i muscoli tesi!
TRANSLATION:
Sonunda! {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Balık Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0003:0014:}} Vaaaaay!
Heyecandan yerimde duramıyorum!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡El Torneo de Pesca está
en marcha!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡Y voy a por
el primer puesto, por supuesto!
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Y ya que estoy en ello, ¡a ver
si supero el récord del mundo!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je le sens bien, ce tournoi !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}On
parie que je vais décrocher la
première place ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Comment j'en suis si sûr ? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ben
parce que je vise carrément un
nouveau record du monde, ha ha !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I put it in writing: a challenge to the
biggest fish in town!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}I only wish that fish could read{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Voy a pescar el pez más grande
de todos! ¡Si no me crees, te lo
puedo declarar ante notario!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Pero que me creas tú me da un
poco igual{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. ¡Lo que me importa
es que me crean los peces!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Tu devrais prendre des notes,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} car
je vais te montrer comment pêcher
comme un{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}} pro !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Par contre, ne va pas montrer ces
notes aux poissons du coin{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Posso anche metterlo per iscritto:
catturerò il pesce più grande!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Spero solo che i pesci non leggano
quello che scrivo, se no eviteranno
la mia canna da pesca{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Kasabanın en büyük balığına meydan
okumamı yazıya döktüm!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Keşke
balık okuyabilseydi{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}All right! Fish like crazy, and win it
all!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}You'll be chasing me, right? It's hard
for me to do my best unless I've got
a serious rival!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}¡Vamos a darle fuerte a esto!
¡A pescar como locos, y a
ganar todo lo ganable a saco!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Tú vas a competir contra mí, ¿no?
¡Yo para superarme necesito un
rival que se lo tome en serio!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Pesca più che puoi e cerca
di vincere!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Mi darai filo da torcere, vero?
Senza un degno rivale non riesco
mai a impegnarmi sul serio.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Also gut!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Ich muss angeln wie ein
Weltmeister, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}und am Ende bin ich{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Champion von {{TAG:0005:0005:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Du bleibst mir hoffentlich dicht auf
den Fersen! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ohne Konkurrenz macht
Siegen keinen Spaß.

{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Tamam! Deliler gibi balık tut, hepsini
kazan!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Peşimden geleceksin, değil
mi? Ciddi rakibim olmadan
en iyimi yapamıyorum!

EN:
How's it going, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
Any luck today? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I'm not gonna let
you outfish me!
ES:
¿Cómo va eso, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
¿Ha habido suerte hoy? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡No voy
a permitir que pesques más que yo!
IT:
Come va, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
Hai pescato qualcosa?
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Non mi lascerò battere!
DE:
Wie läuft's,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}? Was macht
das Anglerglück? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Du hast doch nicht
mehr Fische gefangen als ich, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}oder?

Nasıl gidiyor, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
Şans var mı? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Sana benden fazla balık tutturtmam!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}¿No te preocupa cómo lo hago?
Porque a mí sí me preocupa
cómo lo estás haciendo tú.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Lo que quiero decir es que{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}te espera una buena, ¡así que
ándate con ojo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Tu veux me surveiller pour voir si
j'attrape une prise plus grosse que
la tienne ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Tu devrais{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ou pas !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0021:}}Je préfère
garder la surprise pour le verdict
final, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Hey! Are you just goofing around
because you can't catch anything?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Big mistake! While you're slacking
off, I'm gonna catch a huge fish!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}¡Oye! ¿Estás por ahí tocándote
las narices porque no consigues
pescar nada?
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}¡Pues haces mal! Mientras tú
andas por ahí de cachondeo,
¡yo voy a pescar algo gigantesco!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Hé !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} T'essaies de déconcentrer les
autres sous prétexte que t'attrapes
rien ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Grosse erreur !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} J'ai un esprit de
compète en acier trempé !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Je suis
im{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}per{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}tur{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}bable !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Ehi! Vai a spasso perché non riesci
a catturare nulla?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Che grave errore! Mentre tu sei qui
a perdere tempo, io acciufferò
un pesce enorme!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Hey! Hiçbir şey tutamadığın için
mi oyalanıyorsun?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Büyük hata! Sen boş
dururken ben koca bir balık çekeceğim!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Siento que se me está acabando
el tiempo! Pero esta terrible
presión{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}} ¡es lo mejor que hay!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}No, il tempo sta per finire!
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Però mi piace sentire la pressione
che sale!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Don't let up! Keep going until the
last possible second! If you let your
guard down, you'll lose!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}¡No te rindas! ¡Sigue luchando
hasta el último segundo! ¡Si
bajas la guardia, perderás!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}N'abandonne jamais !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Ne lâche rien
jusqu'à la dernière seconde,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} c'est à
ça qu'on reconnaît les gagnants !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Concentrati! Continua a pescare
fino alla fine. Se ti arrendi, perdi
sicuramente!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Sakın gevşeme! Son saniyeye kadar devam!
Gardını indirirsen kaybedersin!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}What?! How did it get to be so late?
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Gotta catch one more big one at the
last second, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡¿Qué?! ¿Cómo se ha hecho tan
tarde? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Tengo que pescar algo
muy grande en el último segundo!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Eh? Si è già fatto così tardi?
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}C'è ancora tempo per un ultimo
pesce enorme, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Ne?! Saat nasıl bu kadar ilerledi?
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Son saniyede bir büyük balık
daha çekmeliyim, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Wow! Game over!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} Now comes the
nerve-racking wait for the results!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}¡Vaya! ¡Se acabó!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} Y ahora,
¡a temblar de nervios hasta
que salgan los resultados!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Il torneo è finito!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} Ora inizia
la snervante attesa dei risultati!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Wow! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Die Zeit ist um!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Jetzt kommt die nervige Warterei
auf das Ergebnis.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}Vay! Maç bitti!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} Şimdi sinirleri geren
sonuç bekleyişi başlıyor!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡No consigo calmarme!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Estoy
hecho un manojo de nervios{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
y de músculos, claro{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
A ver si salen pronto los resultados,
o voy a tener más nervios que
músculos... ¡y eso no puede ser!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}J'arrive pas à me détendre ! {{TAG:0000:0004:}}Jusqu'à ce qu'on nous annonce les
résultats,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} je me sens comme une
boule de nerfs{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} et de muscles !

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}When are they going to announce
the results? Don't they know my
destiny is riding on this?
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}I'm getting so impatient, I'm about
to storm the tent!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¿Cuándo van a anunciar los
resultados? ¿No saben que mi
destino es ser el número uno?
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Estoy tan impaciente que me voy
a acabar plantando en la tienda
para poner las cosas claras!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Mais ils vont délibérer pendant
encore longtemps ou quoi ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Si ça continue comme ça,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} je vais
rentrer dans la tente pour leur
secouer un peu les puces !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Quando annunceranno i risultati?
Non sanno che sono qui in attesa?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Odio aspettare! Devo trovare
un modo per scaricare la tensione,
magari con 200 flessioni!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Warum brauchen die so lange mit
dem Ergebnis? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Platz eins ist doch
eh schon vergeben!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oder vielleicht auch nicht?!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Heiliger Flatterball!!

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Sonuçları ne zaman açıklayacaklar?
Kaderimin buna bağlı olduğunu
bilmiyorlar mı?
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Sabırsızlıktan çadıra dalmak üzereyim!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I never thought you'd outperform
me in the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Darn it! What's your secret anyway?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Wait. Never mind. I wanna beat you
next time without knowing your
secret, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Nunca pensé que me darías esta
paliza en el Torneo de Pesca{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Maldita sea! ¿Cómo lo has hecho?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Espera... No, no me lo digas. ¡La
próxima vez quiero vencerte sin
saber tu secreto, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Non avrei mai detto che avresti
ottenuto questo risultato al torneo
di pesca{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Per tutti i bicipiti marini, qual è
il tuo segreto?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}No, non dirmelo. La prossima volta
voglio batterti anche senza
conoscerlo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Balık Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}nda beni geçeceğini hiç
düşünmezdim{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Hay aksi! Sırrın ne?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Dur,
boş ver. Bir dahaki sefere sırrını
bilmeden yenmek istiyorum, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Congratulations! {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, the
famous {{TAG:000E:0006:1200660069007300680065007200620072006F001A006C00610064007900660069007300680065007200620072006F00}}! You're quite
the worthy rival!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}I think everyone was secretly

fool me! It's the only explanation!
{{TAG:0003:000E:}}You really worked hard for this, 
didn't you?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Enhorabuena! ¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}},
{{TAG:000E:0006:040065006C0004006C006100}} re{{TAG:000E:0006:02007900060069006E006100}} de la pesca! ¡Eres
u{{TAG:000E:0006:02006E0004006E006100}} adversari{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} de categoría!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:001D:}}Mes félicitations, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Je suis fier d'avoir pu concourir
contre toi !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Je me demande si en fait,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} tu ne te

pour pouvoir me battre !
{{TAG:0003:000E:}}Tant de compétitivité,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ça fait

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tebrikler! {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, meşhur {{TAG:000E:0006:1200660069007300680065007200620072006F001A006C00610064007900660069007300680065007200620072006F00}}! Gerçekten

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Angelturnier {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}heute lief nicht

{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Aber du wirst mich in 100 Jahren
nicht besiegen!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Today's {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} was so

up on that winner's podium is never

{{TAG:0003:0026:}}You'll have to train hard so you can

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}El Torneo de Pesca de hoy

superar mi puesto en el podio.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡Vas a tener que entrenarte

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La compétition était sacrément
serrée aujourd'hui,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} tu trouves pas ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Mais si tu veux être {{TAG:000E:0006:0A0070006C0061006300E9000C0070006C0061006300E9006500}} plus haut
que moi sur le podium, t'es pas au
bout de tes peines, {{TAG:000E:0006:1400700065007400690074002000670061007200730012006D00610020006700720061006E0064006500}}.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Va falloir que tu t'entraînes dur si

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il torneo di pesca è stato faticoso,

alto del mio non è mai un'impresa
facile.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Devi impegnarti e allenarti di più
se vuoi battermi!

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Angelturnier {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}heute war einfach

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}No top finish for you. Does that get
you down?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}What's important is all the sweaty
lessons you learned today!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}No has acabado en cabeza, me
temo. Pero no te deprimas, ¿eh?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Lo importante son todas las
lecciones que has aprendido hoy!
Básicamente, ¡sudar para ganar!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Nessun premio per te oggi.
Sei delus{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}L'importante è che tu abbia
capito i tuoi errori. Solo così
potrai migliorare!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}İlk üç yok. Moralini bozdu mu?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Önemli
olan bugün ter dökerek
öğrendiğin dersler!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}That's too bad about today's
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. {{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}I think you have what it takes to
make it happen next time, though!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Just a wild guess!

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Una pena lo del Torneo de Pesca
de hoy...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}¡Pero tienes madera para que
te vaya mejor la próxima vez!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡O me lo parece a mí, vamos!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}C'est vraiment trop bête que tu
sois si mal {{TAG:000E:0006:0C0063006C00610073007300E9000E0063006C00610073007300E9006500}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Je suis sûr que t'as tout le talent
qu'il faut pour gagner ta place sur
le podium !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}On va dire que cette fois,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} c'était la
faute à pas de chance !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}È stato un torneo di pesca un po'
deludente per te.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Non arrenderti però!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Potrai fare meglio la prossima
volta!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Tut mir leid für dich wegen dem
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Angelturnier {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}heute.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Ich bin mir sicher, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}dass du beim
nächsten Mal besser sein wirst!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Ich hab da so ein Gefühl!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Bugünkü {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Balık Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} için yazık oldu.
{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Ama bir dahaki sefere yapacak güç
sende var bence!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}İçime doğdu!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Disappointing {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} for
you today, huh, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}But a little sweat today will help
you avoid some tears tomorrow!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Time to start practicing for the
next tourney, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}El Torneo de Pesca de hoy
ha sido un poco decepcionante,
¿no, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}¡Pero es mejor sudar hoy que llorar
mañana! {{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡Ahora toca practicar para
el próximo torneo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Dimentichiamoci del torneo di pesca
di oggi, d'accordo, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Non vorrei che ti deprimessi troppo
e ti sentissi come un pesce fuor
d'acqua.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Devi invece iniziare subito
ad allenarti per il prossimo
torneo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Das {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Angelturnier {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}heute lief nicht gut
für dich, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}oder, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Aber wer heute hart trainiert, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}wird
morgen ein Champ sein!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Du solltest gleich mit dem Training
fürs nächste Turnier anfangen,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Bugünkü {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Balık Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} senin için hayal
kırıklığıydı, ha, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Ama bugün
biraz ter, yarın gözyaşını azaltır!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Bir
sonraki turnuva için antrenmana başlama
zamanı, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}What were you doing? The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing
Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} awards ceremony is over!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}You should really check out the
ceremony next time.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} It has this cool
electric atmosphere!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¿Pero tú dónde andabas?
¡La ceremonia de premios del
Torneo de Pesca ya ha acabado!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}La próxima vez no te pierdas
la ceremonia.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} ¡No veas
qué ambientazo había!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Mais où t'étais {{TAG:000E:0006:0A007000610073007300E9000C007000610073007300E9006500}} ?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} La
cérémonie de remise des prix s'est
déroulée sans toi !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}C'est vraiment dommage de l'avoir
ratée.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} Il y règne une ambiance
électrique que j'aime beaucoup !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ma dov'eri? Ti sei pers{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}
la cerimonia di premiazione
del torneo di pesca!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La prossima volta dovresti
esserci.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} Si respira sempre
un'atmosfera particolare!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Wo warst du?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Die Siegerehrung vom
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Angelturnier {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}ist schon vorbei!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Beim nächsten Mal solltest du echt
dabei sein.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} Die Stimmung dort ist
fast wie im Stadion!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Neredeydin? {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Balık Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} ödül töreni
bitti!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Bir dahaki sefere kesin
izlemelisin.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} Ortamın
elektriği acayip iyi!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yay! Today was the best day ever!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} is one of my
favorite competitions!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I hope the next tourney is as
heated as this one was!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Viva! ¡Hoy ha sido el mejor día
de mi vida!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡El Torneo de Pesca es una de
mis competiciones favoritas!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Espero que el próximo torneo
esté tan disputado como este,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yeah ! Je me suis amusé comme
un petit fou !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Participer au tournoi de pêche
m'aide à être en phase avec la
nature !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Un vrai sportif n'est pas seulement
maître de son corps, mais aussi de
son environnement, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Uau! Oggi è stata una giornata
fantastica!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Vado matto per il torneo di pesca!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Spero che il prossimo avrà lo stesso
successo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Jippie! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Was für ein Weltklassetag!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Das {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Angelturnier {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}ist eins meiner
Lieblingsereignisse!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Und dieses Jahr
war's einfach phä{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}no{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}me{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}nal!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich hoffe,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} das nächste Turnier wird
so gut wie dieses, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yaşasın! Bugün hayatımın en iyi
günüydü!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Balık Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} en sevdiğim
yarışmalardan!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bir sonraki de bunun
kadar ateşli olsun!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
This place was crazy during the
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Fishing Tourney{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, but now you could
hear a pin drop.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Heh heh! I hope the next Fishing
Tourney is as exciting as this one
was, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
Hay que ver cuánto jaleo había
con el Torneo de Pesca, ¡pero
ahora está todo muy apagado!
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡Ja, ja! ¡Espero que el próximo
Torneo de Pesca sea igual de
emocionante, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
Si t'avais vu l'ambiance électrique
qu'il y avait ici lors du tournoi de
pêche !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'était quelque chose !
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Hé hé !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} J'espère bien que l'ambiance

survoltée, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !

Che gran confusione che c'era
prima, durante il torneo di pesca.

{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Spero di divertirmi moltissimo
anche la prossima volta,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das Publikum war total heiß bei der
Siegerehrung vom {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Angelturnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Kein
Wunder, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}nach so viel Spannung!
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Ich hoffe,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} das nächste Turnier wird

Burası {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Balık Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} sırasında
çıldırmıştı, şimdi çıt çıkmıyor.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Heh heh! Bir sonraki Balık Turnuvası
da bunun kadar heyecanlı olsun, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Darn it! The awards ceremony was
canceled!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Awww, barbells{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} The ceremony is

amazing you are!

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¡Maldita sea! ¡Han cancelado
la entrega de premios!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Qué mal{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡La ceremonia es la
mejor oportunidad para lucirte y
que todos vean lo molón que eres!

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Mince alors !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} La remise des prix a
été annulée !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Nom d'un poisson pourri{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} S'il y a
bien une occasion en or pour se la
jouer,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} c'est pendant la cérémonie !

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Per tutti i quadricipiti da podio!
Hanno cancellato la cerimonia
di premiazione!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Uff{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Quello è il momento più atteso

stati bravi!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Heiliger Flatterball! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Sie haben die
Siegerehrung abgesagt!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000A:}}So ein Pfostenschuss{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bei der

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ugh{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I was looking forward to the

esto no pase la próxima vez!

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Uff{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Aspettavo con trepidazione
la cerimonia di premiazione, ma
è stata cancellata.
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Questa cosa è davvero frustrante!
Che peccato!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Oh Mann{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich hab mich tierisch auf
die Siegerehrung gefreut. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Aber jetzt
